title: Observe EUR shop wheel pagination against control
platforms: Linux interpreter, EUR fork core; GUI untested
changes: Identify a catalogued EUR overflowing shop list and compare bounded wheel pagination with a no-input control.
validation: At 300 frames the validated list had seven items and four visible; six down and six up requests moved first index 0 to 3 and back while the control stayed at 0. ROM, checkpoint and input hashes were unchanged; isolated release build had no warnings.
limitations: No GUI wheel, scrollbar drag, native dispatch, upstream execution, USA or Android result. A separate frame-600 request was refused after the scene changed; the managed cleanup helper does not accept U31 units.
